t: This Act may be cited as the “Fair Access Foster Care Act of 2005”.

fable.w: This section is only a short-title provision naming the Act. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue by any party outside the federal government. The words "Fair Access" in the title might suggest outside involvement, but they are just part of a proper noun with no actual process attached.

opus.w: This section only gives the Act's short title. It sets up no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue. Words in the title like "Fair Access" are just a name and create no process for outside participation.
opus.b: 1. **Tempting reading:** The words "Fair Access" and "Foster Care" might suggest something about public involvement. That fails because this is only a short-title clause. No decision is made, and no one outside the federal government is consulted.
